# Centrium

> Centrium (published by QuadCore SAS, France) is the operating cockpit for IT services companies (ESN) and consulting firms: CRM, staffing, consultants, missions, timesheets (CRA), pre-invoicing and profitability in one workspace. Tagline: "Pilotez votre ESN. Pas vos tableurs."

## Key facts

- Product: B2B SaaS for IT services companies (ESN) and consulting firms
- Publisher: QuadCore SAS (France)
- Hosting: database, files and application servers located in Sweden (European Union)
- Trial: 7 days
- Languages: French marketing site; the application is available in French and English
- Contact: contact@centrium-platform.com

## Pricing (excl. VAT)

- Starter: €49/month — up to 2 managers and 10 consultants
- Team: €99/month — up to 5 managers and 30 consultants
- Growth: €179/month — up to 10 managers and 100 consultants
- Scale: from €299/month — beyond 10 managers or 100 consultants, priced with the team
- Yearly billing: 10 months paid for 12
- Every module is included in every plan. Client and consultant portal users never count as licences.

## Modules

- Sales: CRM (contacts, companies, opportunities by stage, follow-up tasks), client 360 view, quotes built on templates, private versioned documents
- Talent: consultant profiles (skills, seniority, availability, CV), staffing timeline, explainable matching
- Delivery: missions (dates, sale rate, cost, margin, end-of-mission alerts), monthly timesheets with remote days, approval, pre-invoicing from approved days
- Steering: dashboard, analytics (consultant utilisation, revenue per consultant, lost reasons, timesheet punctuality, quotes), automations
- Portals: client portal (missions, timesheets approval, quotes, documents, new requests) and consultant portal (mission, timesheet, documents)
- Organisation: role-based permissions (admin, business manager, recruiter, finance), global search

## Matching

Deterministic score out of 100 based on seven visible criteria: required skills (50 points), seniority (12), availability (12), nice-to-have skills (10), daily rate (8), languages (5), location (3). No skill is inferred or invented: only skills entered in Centrium count.

## Automations (each can be switched on or off per organisation)

- Mission ending: alerts at 90, 60, 30 and 15 days
- Missing timesheets and timesheets waiting for approval: reminders
- Consultant available: finds compatible open opportunities (score ≥ 75)
- Stale opportunity: creates a follow-up task
- Client request from the portal: creates the CRM opportunity and notifies sales
- Quote expiring within 7 days: creates a follow-up task

## Security (only measures actually deployed)

- Database-level isolation between organisations (Row Level Security), covered by automated regression tests
- Role permissions enforced server-side
- Two-factor authentication (TOTP) required for administrators; 12-character minimum passwords
- Private file storage; downloads through signed links valid for 60 seconds after a permission check
- HTTPS with HSTS; Content-Security-Policy and other security headers
- Audit log of sensitive actions; rate limiting on sensitive routes
- Signed outgoing webhooks (HMAC-SHA256), HTTPS only

## What Centrium is not

- Not an applicant tracking system for public hiring funnels
- Not an autonomous AI: matching is a transparent calculation, and decisions stay with your team
